sections.title: Housing
data: Coast Guard housing in Sault Ste. Marie is 59 homes, duplex style and single family. The sector's housing office helps with both Coast Guard housing and renting in town. Its housing page shows the amenities, floor plans and photos of each house style.
In the Coast Guard, assignment to government housing is generally mandatory when a home is available. Ask the housing office for a release before you rent in town.
